name: rex_short_disagreement_rebound
objective: Add a causal long hedge/alpha sleeve that improves the frozen Gross9 portfolio when a raw REX short setup fails to continue and delayed open interest plus completed-bar price action indicate trapped short inventory.

raw_rex_clock: recompute the REX HTF pullback-reclaim strength and direction directly from completed market bars
fit the q75 positive-strength threshold only on 2020-09-01 through 2021-12-31
sample the raw clock every 24 five-minute bars
retain only raw REX direction SHORT
do not read the future-labelled REX SFT JSONL
anchor: one-bar-delayed 4h OI-minus-price log-return divergence is above the frozen REX-short-anchor quantile
all price, range, flow, ATR, and delayed OI values are finite
confirmation: wait a fixed 30m or 60m after the raw REX short anchor
completed close is above the anchor close
completed 15m taker flow is greater than the anchor completed 1h taker flow
one-bar-delayed OI has not fallen more than the frozen retention allowance
post-anchor downside excursion is no larger than 1.5 times the anchor 1h ATR
completed close is in the frozen upper fraction of the post-anchor high-low range
mechanism.trade: enter a separate LONG sleeve at the next 5m open after confirmation; fixed hold; no take-profit or stop; do not veto or rewrite the existing REX trade

causality_contract.rolling_features: trailing-only and inclusive of the completed decision bar

execution_contract.annualization: declared full calendar window including all idle cash time
execution_contract.strict_mdd: global high-water mark with same-BTC completed-bar upper-before-lower OHLC path

requirements: 2022 and 2023 each have at least 4 accepted trades
2022 plus 2023 has at least 12 accepted trades
combined 2022-2023 absolute return is positive at 0.5x
neither calendar has absolute return below -1.0%
2022, 2023, and combined strict MDD are each no greater than 8.0%
pre2024_shortlist.rank: maximize combined 2022-2023 CAGR/strict-MDD, then minimum annual absolute return, then combined absolute return, then shorter hold, then lexical parameter order

requirements: 2024 candidate has at least 4 accepted trades and absolute return above -1.0%
Gross9 plus the candidate respects train strict MDD <= 40%, 2024 strict MDD <= 20%, and gross <= 10
Gross9 plus the candidate keeps positive train and 2024 absolute return
the candidate improves both the train and 2024 Gross9 CAGR/strict-MDD ratios, or lowers 2024 strict MDD by at least 0.50 percentage points while train ratio falls by no more than 0.10
train and 2024 absolute return each remain at least 97% of the frozen Gross9 baseline
test2024_top1.rank: maximize the minimum train/2024 Gross9 ratio delta, then geometric mean of positive ratio deltas, then 2024 strict-MDD reduction, then 2024 absolute-return delta, then lower added weight, shorter hold, and lexical parameter order

requirements: 2025 and 2026 frozen-portfolio absolute return remain positive
2025 and 2026 frozen-portfolio strict MDD remain <= 20% and CAGR/strict-MDD remain >= 3
neither future Gross9 ratio is reduced by more than 0.25 and at least one future ratio improves
combined 2025-2026 candidate standalone absolute return is positive
10bp/side stress keeps both future frozen-portfolio absolute returns positive

required_diagnostics: exact entry Jaccard versus every Gross9 sleeve
zero-filled daily MTM Pearson and Spearman correlation
candidate contribution on the worst 20 Gross9 drawdown bars
overlap with existing REX short positions and Rank7/Markov long positions
orthogonality_contract.rex_overlap_exception: High overlap with a raw REX short clock is intentional only because the candidate is opposite-side; the exact overlap and portfolio strict-MDD effect must be disclosed.

research_caveat: The wider programme has inspected 2025 and 2026 and the frozen Gross9 sleeves are not globally pristine. This staged protocol prevents new future reranking but any passing result remains forward-shadow only until it survives genuinely new live data.
